string-array.item: Sony hFT-Transformer (ISMIR 2023). Accurate for solo piano, with velocity and live streaming while you record.

MuScriptor medium by Kyutai and Mirelo (2026), full fp32 precision (the original 1.2 GB weights). A 307M-parameter transformer that writes notes directly and also handles other instruments. Slower than the standard app and needs about 2.5 GB of free memory; velocities are fixed.
